title: Infusion Pump Library Anomaly — Decision on Pump Swaps

lines.text: CE to ISO and CNO. The pumps on 4.2.2 are 41. We have 38 spare pumps on the shelf, all on 4.2.1, and no pump server we can trust. I can swap pumps on the highest-risk patients, 22 of them on high-alert drugs, over the next two hours, or I can wait for the maker's advice. Swapping interrupts infusions. Which do you want?

fields.voiceStyle: Middle-aged male, calm but urgent, slightly out of breath

instructorNote: This inject presents the core operational decision: prioritize risk mitigation by swapping pumps on high-alert infusions, or delay and risk unmonitored therapy. Watch for the CNO to authorize the swap protocol and for the ISO to confirm no further changes to ORRMC-PUMP01.
